picks.headline: OpenAI Deploys GPT-5.6 to Kiro Platform for Developer Workloads
picks.why: OpenAI has integrated GPT-5.6 into the Kiro platform to deliver improved price-performance for software engineering tasks.
picks.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro

picks.headline: Meta Open-Sources MetaRoCE Transport for Million-GPU Scale Ethernet Clusters
picks.why: MetaRoCE provides a clean-sheet RDMA transport protocol designed specifically to maintain performance across lossy commodity Ethernet at massive scale.
picks.title: MetaRoCE: A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet

picks.headline: Meta Unveils MTIA 300 Chip with Integrated 800 Gbps RDMA NICs
picks.why: Meta's custom training accelerator offloads collective communication directly to on-package networking engines to eliminate compute bottlenecks.
picks.title: MTIA 300: Meta’s First Training Chip with Built-in NICs and Communication-Offloading Engines

picks.headline: NVIDIA Introduces NVLink Fusion to Connect Custom XPUs to AI Infrastructure
picks.why: NVLink Fusion allows third-party custom accelerators to integrate directly into NVIDIA's scale-up NVLink domain and factory architectures.
picks.title: How XPUs Meet a World-Class AI Factory

picks.headline: Autonomous AI Agents Break Eight Published Cryptographic Schemes Without Human Review
picks.why: Demonstrates that autonomous multi-agent workflows are now capable of executing end-to-end mathematical cryptanalysis against published primitives.
picks.title: AI Grinding for Fun and Cryptanalysis

picks.headline: Audit Shows Most CLAUDE.md Instructions Lack Built-In Enforcement Controls
picks.why: A study of 481 repository configuration files reveals that developers overwhelmingly rely on prompt-level instructions that lack hard runtime enforcement.
picks.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

papers.headline: Mixed SFT Outperforms Next-Chunk Reasoning RL with 60x Less Compute
papers.why: Challenges popular RL scaling trends by showing that supervised fine-tuning post-RLVR reaches higher accuracy ceilings with drastically less training compute.
papers.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data

papers.headline: Bi-Maxwell Dual-Timescale Optimizer Speeds Up LLM Training Over Muon
papers.why: Explains Muon's optimization mechanics through a physical weight-matrix memory model and introduces a dual-timescale optimizer that converges faster.
papers.title: A Physical Response-and-Memory Model for Muon Optimization

papers.headline: Safety-Direction Penalty Prevents Misalignment Caused by LLM Reasoning
papers.why: Identifies representation coupling between reasoning and safety features, offering a loss penalty to stop deep reasoning optimization from degrading safety alignment.
papers.title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
